results.title: Tanvi the Great
results.overview: Autistic young Tanvi Raina learns of her deceased Indian Army father's dream to salute the flag at Siachen Glacier. Despite barriers facing those neurodivergent in military service, she resolves to complete his mission.

results.title: Ginseng Boy
results.overview: Jenny is a gold digger who buys luxury goods with conned money. She runs away to a village in Mt. Jirisan and learns of a thousand-year-old wild ginseng wine that is rumored to be a cure-all. Jenny thinks stealing it from the ailing grandfather and grandson will be a piece of cake. However, from the moment she encounters Doen-jang, the boy who swings a hoe and does strange dances, things spiral out of control.

results.title: Downton Abbey Celebrates the Grand Finale
results.original_title: Downton Abbey Celebrates the Grand Finale
results.overview: Stars of the beloved period drama Downton Abbey reunite at London's Savoy Hotel to share memories and behind-the-scenes tales, plus a sneak peek at the final film.

results.title: 20 ans et un scooter
results.overview: A comedy that follows a young man's journey over the course of a day. For his birthday, he buys himself a second-hand scooter as best he can - a vehicle that belongs in a scrapyard rather than on the road.

results.title: Don’t Peek
results.overview: A professional YouTubing couple - whose career is starting to fray their marriage - grapples with how to leverage the discovery that the previous owner of their new home was not only a serial killer who taped his crimes but also believed his victims were haunting him.

results.title: I'm Not Supposed to Be Here
results.original_title: I'm Not Supposed to Be Here
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at the music industry reveals what artists must face when chasing their passion. Eddie, a Miami-based music artist and lead singer of the international band Toke D Keda, born in Puerto Rico, is determined to achieve success at any cost. When he is denied a rightfully earned recording contract with Sony Music, he must make some tough choices. Giving up is not an option. A relentless pursuit of a lifelong dream takes Eddie on the journey of a lifetime. He will travel to the ends of the world to find himself and his purpose, but at what cost? Eddie suspects someone is stealing money, but this is the least of his problems. As the band's popularity rises, just trying to keep them together may prove impossible.

results.title: AUM: The Cult at the End of the World
results.original_title: AUM: The Cult at the End of the World
results.overview: The shocking story of Aum Shinrikyo, the doomsday cult that unleashed a deadly nerve gas in Tokyo’s subway system in 1995. Founded by disillusioned yoga teacher Shoko Asahara, Aum transformed into a terrorist organization while Japan’s police and media turned a blind eye. Featuring rare archival footage and an interview with one of Asahara’s former high-ranking disciples. A Sundance premiere.

results.title: 3000 km by Bike
results.overview: BMX champion and 2018 Youth Olympic medalist Iñaki Mazza retired from his sport during a period of personal crisis. Years later, he returns to his bike, emboldened by a new quest, and reunites with his partner after their stint at a rehabilitation center in Tierra del Fuego. Mazza sets out on a 3,000-kilometer trek in a cinematic portrait that blends formats, pairing underground BMX footage with beautifully expansive vistas at the end of the world.

results.title: The Christmas Cup
results.overview: After an injury, Staff Sergeant Kelly Brandt returns home for the holidays and her family pushes her to get involved in the annual Christmas Cup against the rival town; with that, she teams up with Fire Captain Quinn Stokley.

results.title: Koyas
results.overview: Two girls leave the courthouse where they have been urged to report their pimp. Although both claim to be proud of their work, one of them has second thoughts about her decision and considers ending her boss and starting a new life.

results.title: Bitter Gold
results.overview: Set in the extinct world of artisan mining in North Chile, this neo western centers the struggles and empowerment of a young woman, fighting to keep the family business against patriarchal structures and the law of the jungle.

results.title: Shark Boy Meets Girl
results.original_title: シャークボーイミーツガール
results.overview: A lonely 40-year-old man falls for the woman he believes is fate. Guided by his late mother’s shark figurine and visions of a giant shark, he’s pulled into love, loss, and a strange awakening.

results.title: L - Langoy
results.overview: A steamy tale of a caretaker's forbidden love for a mysterious attic dweller. They share a passionate relationship filled with sex and life stories but one day she vanishes without a trace.

results.title: The Model
results.overview: After her mother's death, Ana returns to her reclusive father's house and comes across the paintings he creates to cope with grief. She soon discovers how these artworks reveal his deteriorating mental health and blur the boundaries between art and nightmare.

results.title: Long Story Short
results.original_title: Feste & Freunde - Ein Hoch auf uns!
results.overview: A group of close friends celebrate parties over an extended period of time. They experience a lot of fun together, but also tragic moments that prove that love and friendship are the most important gifts of all our lives.

results.title: Dwelling
results.overview: After a young Black couple buys their first home, their American Dream quickly becomes a nightmare when they’re tormented by the ghost of the racist former owner. And when an ill-equipped deacon attempts to expel the ghost, they’re left in even more danger than before.

results.title: A City Fights Back: How LA Defends Itself from ICE
results.original_title: A City Fights Back: How LA Defends Itself from ICE
results.overview: As ICE raids intensify across Los Angeles, a high school teacher leads the grassroots resistance.

results.title: Squid Game in Conversation
results.overview: Take a seat with the director and cast of Squid Game. Discover key moments, hear untold stories and see what this entire journey meant to them.

results.title: The Dispatch
results.overview: On the sketchy side of town, a youngster tries to survive a delivery job gone wrong.
